title: School
rule: Present Simple описує звички й розклад. З I/you/we/they вживай основну форму; з he/she/it додавай -s. Заперечення: don’t/doesn’t + основна форма. Запитання: Do/Does + підмет + основна форма. Час: at nine, in the morning, on school days.
example: Our school starts at nine. My friend studies music. Does she practise every day? She does not practise at the weekend.
reading: Our school has a theatre and a science lab. We study the usual subjects, but we also learn dance and music. Classes start at nine and finish at four. After school, some students practise in the theatre. I enjoy biology because I like learning about animals.

questions.prompt: She ___ music every day.
questions.why: З she у Present Simple додаємо -s; study → studies.

questions.prompt: ___ your classes start at nine?
questions.why: Classes — множина, тому Do + основна форма.

questions.prompt: He ___ work in the lab on school days.
questions.why: He + does not + основна форма work.

questions.prompt: Where do some students practise after school?
Why does the writer enjoy biology?
choices: The writer likes learning about animals.
The writer wants to be an actor.
questions.why: Причина прямо вказана в останньому реченні.

write.prompt: Опиши свою або вигадану школу у 5–6 реченнях: приміщення, предмети, розклад і улюблений предмет.
write.starter: Our school has… Classes start at… My favourite subject is… because…

title: Appearance
rule: Риси зовнішності описуємо через be і have got: He is tall. He has got curly hair. Для дії зараз використовуємо Present Continuous (Progressive): am/is/are + дієслово з -ing. У запитанні am/is/are стоїть перед підметом.
example: She has got long wavy hair. She is wearing glasses. What is she doing? She is reading.
reading: Two friends are looking for a player in an online game. The player is tall and slim. He has got short brown hair and is wearing glasses. He is standing near a tree in the park. One friend sees a player with black hair, but that is the wrong person.

questions.prompt: She ___ a book at the moment.
They ___ near a tree now.
What ___ he doing?
questions.why: Запитання в Present Continuous: What is he doing?

questions.prompt: What colour is the right player's hair?
Where is the right player standing?
questions.why: У тексті вказано near a tree in the park.

write.prompt: Опиши вигаданого персонажа: зовнішність, одяг і дві дії, які він виконує зараз.
write.starter: My character is… They have got… They are wearing… They are…

title: Character
rule: Present Simple — звичка: usually, often, every day. Present Continuous — дія зараз або тимчасова ситуація: now, at the moment, these days. Дієслова like, love, want, know, need, understand зазвичай вживаємо у Simple, навіть коли говоримо про теперішнє.
example: I usually wear jeans. Today I am making a skirt. I want a blue patch. I like the new design.
reading: A girl usually buys her clothes, but today she is changing an old pair of jeans into a skirt. She is drawing a butterfly on a pocket. The drawing looks awful, so her friend gives her a patch. They put it over the drawing and make a new design together.

questions.prompt: She usually ___ trainers to school.
questions.why: Usually указує на звичку; she + wears.

questions.prompt: Look! They ___ a skirt.
I ___ this blue patch.
questions.why: Like зазвичай не вживаємо у Continuous.

questions.prompt: What is the girl making?
Why do they use a patch?

write.prompt: Порівняй свій звичайний одяг і одяг сьогодні. Напиши 3 речення зі звичками та 3 з діями зараз.
write.starter: I usually wear… Today I am wearing… I like…

title: Free time
rule: Після enjoy і can’t stand використовуй -ing. У цьому уроці після like/love/hate також тренуємо -ing. Після want і would like потрібен to + основна форма. Would you like to…? — ввічлива пропозиція, а Do you like…? — запитання про вподобання.
example: I enjoy playing table tennis. I cannot stand singing karaoke. I would like to join a youth club.
reading: Two friends want to join a youth club. They enjoy playing computer games and table tennis. One of them does not like karaoke, but there are other activities. His sister loves arts and crafts. The club is open until ten tonight, so the friends decide to go there after school.

questions.prompt: I enjoy ___ table tennis.
Would you like ___ our club?
She does not want ___ early.
Which activity does the sister love?
questions.why: У тексті: loves arts and crafts.

questions.prompt: When does the club close tonight?
questions.why: Open until ten означає, що клуб працює до десятої.

write.prompt: Напиши про три улюблені заняття, одне нелюбиме й одне, яке хочеш спробувати.
write.starter: I enjoy… I love… I cannot stand… I would like to…

title: My friend's profile
rule: What do you look like? — про зовнішність. What are you like? — про характер. Групуй інформацію в абзаци: спершу про себе, потім про друга і спільні заняття. Порядок слів: підмет + дієслово + додаток; прикметник стоїть перед іменником або після be.
example: My friend has got curly hair. She is helpful. We play ice hockey together. She is a friendly person.
reading: I am tall and have got curly dark hair. I am active and outgoing, and I love sports. My best friend is short and has got blue eyes. He is clever and helpful, so I like studying with him. We both play ice hockey for a local team.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct order.
A question about personality is…
questions.why: What are you like? запитує про характер.

questions.prompt: Choose the natural sentence.
Why does the writer like studying with the friend?
choices: The friend is clever and helpful.
questions.why: Причина — риси характеру clever і helpful.

questions.prompt: What do the friends do together?
questions.why: В останньому реченні названо ice hockey.

write.prompt: Напиши два абзаци про себе та вигаданого друга: зовнішність, характер і спільні заняття.
write.starter: About me: I am… I have got… My best friend is… We both…

title: Holiday activity
rule: Past Simple описує завершену дію в минулому: yesterday, last summer, two days ago. Правильні дієслова отримують -ed; неправильні мають окрему форму: go → went, ride → rode, take → took. Заперечення і запитання: didn’t/Did + основна форма. Be має форми was/were.
example: We went on a cruise. I took photos. Did you buy souvenirs? I did not ride a horse.
reading: A girl returned from a holiday in Egypt. She visited famous sights and went on a cruise. She also rode a camel. She was scared because the camel was tall, but she did not fall off. She bought souvenirs for her friends. She left her camera at home and could not show her photos.

questions.prompt: Last summer we ___ on a cruise.
Did you ___ any photos?
She ___ fall off the camel.
Why was the girl scared?
Why could she not show her photos?

write.prompt: Опиши справжні або вигадані канікули у 6 реченнях у Past Simple.
write.starter: Last summer I went… I visited… I took… I did not…

title: Transport
rule: Can/can’t описує здібність зараз; could/couldn’t — у минулому. Прислівник відповідає на запитання «як?»: careful → carefully, easy → easily. Good → well, а fast і hard не змінюються. By bus/by train, але on foot.
example: He could not find the river. She drives carefully. We travelled by ferry and walked on foot.
reading: A visitor wanted to find a restaurant near a river. First he walked, then he took a bus. The traffic was slow, so he used the underground. A man told him that the restaurant was on the other side of the river. He took a ferry, but the restaurant was closed when he arrived.

questions.prompt: She is a careful driver. She drives ___.
I ___ swim when I was five, but now I can.
questions.why: When I was five — минуле: could not.

questions.prompt: He speaks very ___.
Why did the visitor leave the bus?
questions.why: У тексті згадано повільний дорожній рух.

questions.prompt: Was the restaurant open when he arrived?
questions.why: Останнє речення: the restaurant was closed.

write.prompt: Порівняй два види транспорту: зручність, ціна, швидкість. Додай одну здібність у минулому.
write.starter: I usually travel by… because… I could… when I was…

title: Travel preparations
rule: Особовий займенник-підмет стоїть перед дієсловом: I, he, she, we, they. Об’єктні форми — після дієслова або прийменника: me, him, her, us, them. Give it to her. Ask him. Для підготовки до подорожі тренуй запитання Did you book/check/pack…?
example: We booked a flight. The tickets are for us. Give them to me. Did you pack your passport?
reading: Two friends are preparing for a trip. They check their passports and pack one large suitcase and a small bag. They check the weather and decide to take jumpers. They can check in online and download their boarding passes. Their parents will drive them to the airport.

questions.prompt: These tickets are for ___.
questions.why: Після for потрібна об’єктна форма us.

questions.prompt: I called my brother. I asked ___ to help.
Give the boarding passes to ___.
Why do the friends take jumpers?
How can they get their boarding passes?
questions.why: У тексті: download their boarding passes.

write.prompt: Склади список підготовки й 4 запитання до друга: квитки, погода, паспорт, багаж.
write.starter: Did you book…? Did you check…? Give… to me. We need…

title: Travelling then and now
rule: Used to + основна форма описує минулу звичку або стан, що змінився. У запитаннях і запереченнях після did пишемо use to: Did people use to…? People didn’t use to… . Для окремої завершеної події використовуємо Past Simple.
example: People used to travel on slow ships. Did they use to spend months at sea? Trains did not use to be so fast.
reading: Travel has changed. Explorers used to spend months at sea before they saw land. Early trains were much slower than many trains today. Travelling by plane used to be difficult, but now people can cross long distances quickly. Electric cars are another way to travel, and drivers need places to charge them.

questions.prompt: People ___ travel on slow ships.
Did trains ___ be so fast?
They did not ___ travel by plane.
questions.why: Після did not немає -d у use.

questions.prompt: What did explorers sometimes wait months to see?
questions.why: У тексті: before they saw land.

questions.prompt: What do electric cars need?
questions.why: Останнє речення пояснює потребу в заряджанні.

write.prompt: Напиши три речення про транспорт колись і три про транспорт зараз.
write.starter: People used to… Now they… Trains did not use to…

title: A school trip
rule: Лист про минулу поїздку має вітання, факти, враження й завершення. And додає інформацію; but показує протиставлення; because називає причину; so — наслідок. Для подій поїздки використовуй Past Simple.
example: We visited a museum and watched a film. We were tired, so we went home. I liked the trip because it was exciting.
reading: Last week our class went by coach to a science museum. The journey took two hours because of the traffic. We saw inventions and fossils and watched a film. My favourite place was the experiment room. We could do experiments there. We were tired at the end, but we had a fantastic day.

questions.prompt: We stayed inside ___ it was raining.
We were tired, ___ we went home.
The trip was long, ___ it was exciting.
How did the class travel?
questions.why: У першому реченні: went by coach.

questions.prompt: Which room did the writer like best?
questions.why: My favourite place was the experiment room.

write.prompt: Напиши лист другу про шкільну поїздку: маршрут, дві події та враження. Використай and, but, because, so.
write.starter: Hi… Last week we… My favourite place was… Speak to you soon!

title: Accident
rule: Past Continuous (Progressive): was/were + дієслово з -ing. Це дія, що тривала у певний момент минулого. I/he/she/it → was; we/you/they → were. Заперечення: wasn’t/weren’t. У запитанні Was/Were стоїть перед підметом.
example: I was walking at five. They were skateboarding. Was the driver going fast? She was not looking at her phone.
reading: A boy was skateboarding on the pavement. A woman was driving a car. A cat was in the middle of the street, so the driver swerved and crashed into a tree. The car did not hit the boy, but he fell down and hurt his knee. A neighbour called an ambulance.

questions.prompt: At five I ___ home.
questions.why: Дія тривала в певний момент минулого.

questions.prompt: They ___ football at that time.
___ the driver going fast?
questions.why: Past Continuous запитання: Was the driver going…?

questions.prompt: Why did the driver swerve?
choices: There was a cat in the street.

questions.prompt: Did the car hit the boy?
questions.why: У тексті прямо вказано, що машина не збила хлопця.

write.prompt: Опиши вигадану безпечну пригоду: що робили троє людей і що сталося.
write.starter: A boy was… A woman was… Suddenly… A neighbour…

title: Mysteries
rule: Past Continuous задає фон, Past Simple — подію, що перервала дію. While часто вводить тривалу дію. When може вводити коротку подію. Для двох одночасних тривалих дій використовуй Continuous в обох частинах.
example: While we were walking, we heard a noise. I was looking at the snow when I saw footprints. She was reading while he was drawing.
reading: Two friends were exploring a snowy area when they saw huge footprints. The footprints looked like human footprints, but they were much bigger. The friends were frightened and ran back to the campsite. Other people thought a wild animal made them. The friends could not explain what they saw.

questions.prompt: While we ___, we heard a noise.
I was reading when the phone ___.
She was drawing while he ___ music.
What was unusual about the footprints?
choices: They were much bigger than human footprints.

questions.prompt: Where did the friends run?
questions.why: У тексті: ran back to the campsite.

write.prompt: Придумай таємничу історію у 5–6 реченнях. Додай while, when і пояснення, яке може бути правдоподібним.
write.starter: While we were… we saw… We felt… Perhaps…

title: What happened?
rule: Some зазвичай уживаємо у ствердженнях, а також у пропозиціях: Would you like some…? Any — у запитаннях і запереченнях. No означає відсутність і стоїть зі стверджувальним дієсловом: There is no food. Не додавай ще одне not.
example: There are some rides. Are there any long queues? There is no food left. Would you like some lemonade?
reading: Two boys went on a water ride at a funfair. One boy was eating a sandwich when the boat went down a hill. Ketchup got on his shirt. The boat splashed into water, and the water washed some ketchup off. There were no roller coasters, but the boys enjoyed the other rides.

questions.prompt: Are there ___ tickets left?
There are ___ interesting rides here.
We have not got ___ lemonade.
What was the boy eating?
Were there roller coasters?

write.prompt: Напиши про вигаданий парк розваг: що там є, чого немає, і що сталося під час одного атракціону.
write.starter: There are some… There are no… I was… when…

title: Emotions
rule: Someone/somebody — хтось; something — щось; somewhere — десь. Anyone/anything/anywhere часто в запитаннях і запереченнях. Nobody/nothing/nowhere уже містять заперечення. Everyone/everything/everywhere — усі/усе/скрізь. З everyone і nobody використовуємо однину дієслова.
example: Everyone is afraid. Nobody knows the answer. Is there anything to eat? I can hear something.
reading: Two men were travelling through a cold forest with their dogs. Wolves were following them. One wolf looked different because it was half dog. A dog ran towards it, and other wolves appeared. One man tried to chase them, but he did not return. The other man felt alone and afraid.

questions.prompt: ___ knows the answer. We need help.
questions.why: Nobody — ніхто; речення вже заперечне за змістом.

questions.prompt: Is there ___ to eat?
Everyone ___ ready.
Why did one wolf look different?
questions.why: Це деталь із тексту, адаптованого за історією White Fang.

questions.prompt: How did the man feel at the end?
questions.why: Останнє речення прямо називає його почуття.

write.prompt: Опиши почуття героя в трьох моментах історії. Використай someone, something або nobody.
write.starter: At first the character felt… Then… In the end…

title: Unlucky story
rule: Історія має початок (хто, де, коли), розвиток подій і завершення. Past Continuous описує фон, Past Simple — події. Suddenly додає несподівану подію; luckily/fortunately — добрий поворот; unfortunately — невдачу. Завершуй історію результатом і почуттями героя.
example: I was walking home when I lost my keys. Unfortunately, the door was locked. Luckily, a neighbour helped me.
reading: A boy ran into his garden, and the door closed behind him. He had no keys or phone. Luckily, his bedroom window was open, so he climbed a ladder. A police officer saw him and thought he was a burglar. A neighbour explained that it was the boy’s house. In the end, the boy got inside safely.

questions.prompt: ___, I lost my keys and could not get inside.
I was climbing when the officer ___ me.
Choose a clear ending.
choices: In the end, we got home safely.

questions.prompt: Why did the boy use a ladder?
choices: He wanted to repair the roof.
questions.why: Відкрите вікно було способом потрапити в дім.

questions.prompt: Who explained the situation?
questions.why: Сусід пояснив поліцейському, чий це будинок.

write.prompt: Напиши історію на 7–8 речень з початком, пригодою та завершенням. Додай дві емоції й when/while.
write.starter: It happened… I was… when… Unfortunately… Luckily… In the end…

title: Around town
rule: Can I…? і May I…? запитують дозволу. Could you…? — ввічливе прохання. Could I help you…? — пропозиція допомоги. May/might + основна форма можуть виражати можливість: It might rain. Після цих модальних дієслів немає to або -s.
example: May I borrow this book? Could you help me? I might visit the market later.
reading: A boy wants to borrow a book from the library, but he has left his card at home. The librarian says he cannot borrow it without a card. She suggests asking a friend to borrow the book for him. At another shop, a girl wants a newspaper and a magazine. The shopkeeper checks the shelf.

questions.prompt: ___ I borrow this book, please?
Could you ___ the window, please?
It ___ rain later, but I am not sure.
Why cannot the boy borrow the book himself?
choices: He has no library card with him.

questions.prompt: Where does the shopkeeper look for the magazine?

write.prompt: Напиши три короткі діалоги: в бібліотеці, крамниці та на пошті. Додай ввічливі прохання.
write.starter: Could you… please? May I…? Yes, of course. Thank you.

title: How to get there
rule: Для маршруту використовуй наказову форму: Go straight on. Turn left/right. Go past the bank. Прийменники місця: next to, opposite, in front of, behind. Рух: into — усередину, out of — назовні, through — крізь, across — через, along/down — уздовж.
example: Go straight on and turn right at the traffic lights. The bank is on your left, opposite the park.
reading: Two friends are playing a game. One asks how to get to the bank. His friend tells him to go straight on and turn right at the traffic lights. Later they go past a bus stop and turn left. They stop in front of a supermarket. The house they need is behind it.

questions.prompt: To move inside a building, go ___.
The bank faces the park. It is ___ the park.
Choose a direction.
choices: Turn left at the traffic lights.

questions.prompt: Where do the friends stop?
questions.why: У тексті: stop in front of a supermarket.

questions.prompt: Where is the house they need?

write.prompt: Намалюй просту мапу з чотирма місцями. Напиши маршрут від школи до одного з них.
write.starter: Go straight on… Turn… Go past… It is on your…

title: City vs countryside
rule: Порівняння: short adjective + -er + than; more + long adjective + than. Big → bigger, easy → easier. Good → better, bad → worse. As + прикметник + as показує рівність; not as… as — менший ступінь ознаки. Після as не використовуй -er.
example: The country is quieter than the city. The city is more exciting. This house is as comfortable as that one.
reading: Some people enjoy a busy city with shops and restaurants. Other people prefer the countryside because it is quieter and more peaceful. A houseboat can be cheaper than a large house. A caravan lets people travel with their home. The best choice depends on the person’s interests and daily life.

questions.prompt: The country is ___ than the city.
This sofa is as ___ as my bed.
questions.why: As… as потребує звичайної форми прикметника.

questions.prompt: This view is ___ than that one.
Why do some people prefer the countryside?
choices: It is quieter and more peaceful.

questions.prompt: What can a caravan let people do?
questions.why: У тексті: travel with their home.

write.prompt: Порівняй два місця, де хотів би жити. Додай два порівняння й одне речення з as… as.
write.starter: The city is… than… The country is more… This place is as… as…

title: Outer space
rule: Найвищий ступінь: the + -est або the most + прикметник. Large → largest, hot → hottest, easy → easiest. Good → the best, bad → the worst. Порівняльний ступінь порівнює два об’єкти, найвищий — один об’єкт з усією групою.
example: This is the largest planet in the group. That planet is hotter than this one. It has the highest temperature.
reading: Our solar system contains the sun and eight planets. Planets differ in size, temperature and distance from the sun. A small planet is not always the coldest one. To compare planets, look at the data carefully. Use bigger than for two planets and the biggest for one planet in a whole group.

questions.prompt: Choose the superlative of large.
It is the ___ place in this group.
This is ___ interesting fact of all.
questions.why: Для довгого прикметника: the most interesting.

questions.prompt: How many planets are in our solar system?
questions.why: У першому реченні названо eight planets.

questions.prompt: Which form compares one planet with a whole group?
questions.why: Для всієї групи використовується найвищий ступінь.

write.prompt: Придумай таблицю для трьох вигаданих планет: розмір, температура, відстань. Напиши 5 порівнянь.
write.starter: Planet one is bigger than… Planet two is the… Planet three is as… as…

title: Where I live
rule: Опис місця організуй у три абзаци: розташування й основні факти; цікаві місця; власна думка та заняття. There is + однина; there are + множина. Для загальних фактів використовуй Present Simple, а для оцінки — прикметники й порівняння.
example: There is a castle near the river. There are two galleries. The park is the most peaceful place in my town.
reading: I live in a city with a river and several bridges. There are museums, art galleries and a large stadium. Many visitors enjoy the view from the old bridge. My favourite place is the park because my friends and I can cycle there. I think our city is a great place to live.

questions.prompt: There ___ two galleries in my town.
There ___ a castle near the river.
Which sentence gives an opinion?
choices: I think this city is beautiful.
questions.why: I think указує на власну оцінку.

questions.prompt: Where does the writer like cycling?
questions.why: У тексті велосипедні прогулянки відбуваються в парку.

questions.prompt: What do many visitors enjoy?
choices: The view from the old bridge.
questions.why: У тексті: enjoy the view from the old bridge.

write.prompt: Опиши своє або вигадане місто в трьох коротких абзацах. Додай факти, місця й власну думку.
write.starter: I live in… There is… There are… My favourite place is…

title: Computer parts
rule: Be going to + основна форма описує намір або план. Узгоджуй be: I am, he/she/it is, we/you/they are. Запитання: Are you going to…? Заперечення: isn’t/aren’t going to… . Для домовленості з конкретним часом також можна використати Present Continuous.
example: I am going to buy a keyboard. Are you going to visit the technology fair? We are meeting at ten.
reading: Two friends want to visit a technology fair at the weekend. They are going to look at new computers and game consoles. One friend needs a keyboard because the old one does not work. They are meeting at the entrance at ten. They are not going to buy everything they see.

questions.prompt: She ___ going to visit the fair.
Are you going to ___ a printer?
We ___ meeting at ten tomorrow.
What does one friend need?
questions.why: У тексті старий keyboard не працює.

questions.prompt: Where are the friends meeting?
questions.why: У тексті: at the entrance at ten.

write.prompt: Склади план вихідного дня: три наміри, одна домовленість і одна дія, якої не плануєш.
write.starter: I am going to… We are meeting… I am not going to…

title: Gadgets
rule: Will + основна форма: прогноз, обіцянка, пропозиція допомоги або рішення в момент мовлення. Заперечення: won’t. Запитання: Will you…? I think/probably/maybe показують ступінь упевненості. Will be able to — зможе; will be + -ing може описувати заплановану майбутню дію.
example: I think gadgets will change. I will help you. Will you bring the headphones? We will be leaving at eight.
reading: A teenager asks for advice about wireless headphones. One person recommends a cheaper pair. Another says the same headphones work with a phone but sometimes fail with a computer. A third person recommends a more expensive pair with better sound. The teenager decides to visit an electronics shop and compare them.

questions.prompt: I think phones ___ change in the future.
I promise I ___ return your headphones.
Will you ___ me, please?
Why does one person dislike the cheaper headphones?
choices: They sometimes fail with a computer.

questions.prompt: What will the teenager do next?

write.prompt: Напиши 4 прогнози про ґаджети майбутнього й одну обіцянку допомогти другові.
write.starter: I think… will… Maybe… I am sure… I will help…

title: Recycling
rule: Must/have to — необхідність. Mustn’t/can’t — заборона. Don’t have to — відсутність необхідності: можна, але не обов’язково. Минула форма must/have to — had to. Правила сортування можуть відрізнятися: завжди звіряй напис на місцевому контейнері.
example: You must check the label. You must not leave rubbish here. You do not have to buy a new bag. We had to clean the room.
reading: A boy wants to recycle a bottle. His friend explains that the container is for glass, but his bottle is plastic. She tells him to rinse it and check the correct bin. She also gives him a leaflet about recycling. They agree that keeping the environment clean is something everyone can help with.

questions.prompt: A rule forbids dropping rubbish. You ___ drop it.
It is not necessary. You ___ do it.
Yesterday we ___ clean the room.
What is the boy's bottle made of?
questions.why: У тексті: his bottle is plastic.

questions.prompt: What does the friend give him?
questions.why: У тексті згадано leaflet about recycling.

write.prompt: Напиши чотири правила для класу: обов’язок, заборону, необов’язкову дію та вчорашній обов’язок.
write.starter: We have to… We must not… We do not have to… Yesterday we had to…

title: Animal protection
rule: First Conditional описує можливу ситуацію: if + Present Simple, will + основна форма. У частині з if також можливі can/may/might/must або наказова форма в головній частині. Не став will у звичайній умові з if. Якщо if-частина на початку, відділяй її комою.
example: If we protect the river, animals will have a safer home. If you see rubbish, pick it up. Animals may disappear if we do not help.
reading: Some dolphins are endangered. They need clean water and air to breathe. Fishing nets, careless boat users and pollution can harm them. If people protect their habitat, the dolphins will have a better chance to survive. We can help by keeping rivers clean and learning about the animals that live there.

questions.prompt: If we ___ the water, animals will suffer.
If people protect the habitat, animals ___ a better chance.
If you see rubbish, ___ it up.
questions.why: У головній частині може бути наказова форма.

questions.prompt: Why do dolphins need air?
questions.why: У тексті прямо вказано air to breathe.

questions.prompt: Which danger is mentioned?

write.prompt: Напиши 5 речень про захист середовища тварин, використовуючи if.
write.starter: If we… animals will… If you see… We can…

title: An environmental event
rule: У запрошенні назви подію, місце, дату, час і заняття. Would you like to come…? — запрошення; Thanks for inviting me. I’d love to. — згода; I’m sorry, but I can’t… — ввічлива відмова. Для планів використовуй going to, а if — для умови відповіді.
example: Would you like to come to our clean-up? We are going to meet at nine. If you can come, write back.
reading: Our youth club is organising a tree-planting event. We are going to meet at the club at eight and walk to the park. We will plant trees in the morning and have a meal together later. I hope you can join us. If you decide to come, please send a reply.

questions.prompt: Choose an invitation.
choices: Would you like to come to our event?

questions.prompt: Choose a polite acceptance.
questions.why: I would love to come — згода.

questions.prompt: Which detail should an invitation include?
questions.why: Гостю потрібно знати, де й коли подія.

questions.prompt: When will the group meet?
questions.why: У тексті: meet at the club at eight.

questions.prompt: What should the friend send?
questions.why: В останньому реченні просять send a reply.

write.prompt: Напиши запрошення на екоподію і дві відповіді: згоду та ввічливу відмову.
write.starter: Hi… Would you like to…? We are going to… Thanks for… I am sorry, but…

title: Healthy food
rule: Much/how much/a little + незлічуваний іменник: water, milk, sugar. Many/how many/a few + злічуваний іменник у множині: apples, meals. A lot of/lots of підходить до обох типів. A few/a little означають, що невелика кількість є.
example: How much milk is there? How many apples have we got? There is a little water and a few vegetables.
reading: A balanced diet can include different kinds of food. Fruit and vegetables provide vitamins. Dairy products contain protein and calcium. Some fast food contains a lot of salt, sugar or fat. A student compares two meals and notices that one has more vegetables. The student chooses that meal and drinks water.

questions.prompt: How ___ apples have we got?
There is a ___ milk left.
We have a ___ carrots.
What do dairy products contain in the text?
questions.why: У тексті названо protein and calcium.

questions.prompt: What does the student drink?

write.prompt: Опиши два вигадані обіди. Використай many, much, a few, a little, a lot of.
write.starter: Meal one has… Meal two has… There is a little… There are a few…

title: Ailments and illnesses
rule: Should/shouldn’t + основна форма — порада. Should I…? запитує поради. Мовні приклади про самопочуття допомагають пояснити проблему дорослому. Для конкретного лікування звертайся до дорослого та медичного фахівця.
example: I have got a headache. You should tell an adult. You should not ignore it. Should I ask for help?
reading: A girl calls her friend because he has not arrived at the cinema. He says he is ill and has got a headache and a cough. She offers to visit him, but then she hears another friend cheering for a football match. The boy admits that they are watching football. He promises to tell the truth next time.

questions.prompt: You should ___ an adult how you feel.
You ___ ignore a problem.
___ I ask for help?
Where was the girl waiting?
questions.why: Вона телефонувала через його відсутність у кіно.

questions.prompt: What were the boys actually doing?
questions.why: Хлопець визнав, що вони дивляться football.

write.prompt: Склади три короткі діалоги: назви самопочуття, попроси допомоги, дай загальну пораду з should.
write.starter: I have got… Should I…? You should tell…

title: Facts about sports
rule: Question tag уточнює твердження. Після ствердження хвостик заперечний, після заперечення — стверджувальний. Повтори допоміжне дієслово: is → isn’t, can → can’t, likes → doesn’t, played → didn’t. У хвостику заміни підмет займенником.
example: You like tennis, do you not? She is the instructor, is she not? They cannot swim, can they?
reading: Two friends visit a gym. One likes using the machines and lifting weights. The other prefers an aerobics class and wants advice from an instructor. They discuss different ways to exercise. They agree that a person should choose an activity they enjoy and can practise regularly.

questions.prompt: She is the instructor, ___?
questions.why: Після ствердження з is — isn’t she.

questions.prompt: You like tennis, ___?
questions.why: Present Simple з you → don’t you.

questions.prompt: They cannot swim, ___?
Who wants advice from an instructor?
questions.why: У тексті це друг, який обирає aerobics.

questions.prompt: What do the friends agree about?
questions.why: В останньому реченні сформульована їхня спільна думка.

write.prompt: Напиши 5 тверджень про спортивні вподобання з question tags і короткі відповіді на них.
write.starter: You like… don’t you? Yes, I do. She is… isn’t she?

title: Football
rule: Про звичайну діяльність команди використовуй Present Simple, про завершені матчі — Past Simple. Відрізняй match (матч), league (ліга), trophy (нагорода), spectator (глядач). Описуй спершу команду й місце, потім досягнення та причину, чому вона подобається.
example: Our team plays in the local league. Last year they won a trophy. Many spectators watched the final.
reading: A sports club can have more than one team. It may include football, basketball and hockey teams. Supporters watch matches and celebrate trophies. A successful club can change managers and players over the years. When you describe a favourite team, explain where it plays and why you support it.

questions.prompt: Yesterday the team ___ a trophy.
A person who watches a match is a ___.
They ___ in the local league every year.
questions.why: Every year — регулярна дія у Present Simple.

questions.prompt: Can one club have several teams?
questions.why: Перші два речення називають різні команди клубу.

questions.prompt: What should a description explain?
choices: Where the team plays and why you support it.

write.prompt: Опиши справжню або вигадану команду: вид спорту, місце, минуле досягнення та причину підтримки.
write.starter: My favourite team plays… Last year they… I support them because…

title: Get active!
rule: У листі про нове заняття поєднуй часи: Past Simple — коли почав і що вже сталося; Present Simple — як часто займаєшся; be going to — майбутні плани. Перевіряй часові слова в кожному реченні.
example: I joined the tennis club last year. I practise three times a week. I am going to enter a tournament.
reading: A girl joined a tennis club after a friend gave her advice. She practises three times a week with another member. The coach says she is doing well. Last week she won her first match. In two weeks she is going to take part in a tournament. She writes to a friend to share the news.

questions.prompt: Last year I ___ a tennis club.
I ___ three times a week.
Next week I am going to ___ in a tournament.
How often does the girl practise?
What is her next plan?
questions.why: Вона планує турнір через два тижні.

write.prompt: Напиши лист про нове заняття. Зазнач, коли почав, як часто займаєшся і що плануєш.
write.starter: Hi… I took up… I practise… Last week… I am going to…

title: TV programmes
rule: Present Perfect: have/has + третя форма дієслова. Для досвіду без конкретного завершеного часу використовуй ever/never/before. Запитання: Have you ever…? Have seen, have watched, has won. Не поєднуй цей час із yesterday або last week.
example: Have you ever watched a talent show? I have seen it twice. She has never won a competition.
reading: Two boys are contestants on a game show. They must answer five questions about their friends to win a prize. One boy answers too quickly and makes mistakes. They answer only three questions correctly. They do not win, even though the other boy knew more answers. Listening to each other would have helped.

questions.prompt: Have you ever ___ a talent show?
She ___ never won a prize.
Choose a question about experience.
choices: Have you ever appeared on TV?
Are you ever appear on TV?
questions.why: Досвід без конкретної дати: Have you ever…?

questions.prompt: How many correct answers did the boys need?
questions.why: У другому реченні названо five questions.

questions.prompt: Why did they fail to win?
choices: One boy answered too quickly and made mistakes.

write.prompt: Напиши 5 запитань Have you ever…? про різний досвід і дай власні або вигадані відповіді.
write.starter: Have you ever…? Yes, I have. I have… No, I have never…

title: Music
rule: Present Perfect — досвід без завершеної дати: I have been to a concert. Past Simple — конкретна подія: I went last night. Have been to — відвідав і повернувся; have gone to — пішов і ще не повернувся. Yet у запитаннях і запереченнях, already — уже.
example: I have seen this band twice. I saw them last summer. My brother has gone to the concert, so he is not here.
reading: A fan has been to several concerts, but one performance was especially exciting. Last summer she saw a live band with a friend. At first it was dark and she felt nervous. Then the lights came on and the audience started singing. She enjoyed the music and decided to see the band again.

questions.prompt: I ___ the band last night.
questions.why: Last night — завершений час, Past Simple.

questions.prompt: She has ___ to the shop and is not back yet.
questions.why: Gone означає, що людина ще там або в дорозі.

questions.prompt: Have you booked the tickets ___?
questions.why: Yet підходить до запитання у Present Perfect.

questions.prompt: When did the fan see the band in the story?
questions.why: У тексті прямо вказано last summer.

questions.prompt: How did she feel at first?
questions.why: Перед увімкненням світла вона felt nervous.

write.prompt: Розкажи про музичний досвід і одну конкретну подію. Використай обидва часи.
write.starter: I have been to… Last… I went… I have never…

title: Messages
rule: Present Perfect з for/since описує стан, що почався раніше й триває зараз. For + період: for two years. Since + початок: since Monday. How long have you…? — як довго? У записці чи повідомленні пиши, що сталося, коли повернешся або що потрібно зробити.
example: I have lived here for two years. We have known each other since school. I will be back at six.
reading: People sometimes shorten words in messages to type faster. They also use symbols to show feelings. A short message can be useful, but it must be clear to the receiver. A note about a borrowed bike should say who took it and when it will be returned. Clarity matters more than using many symbols.

questions.prompt: I have lived here ___ two years.
We have known each other ___ last summer.
How long ___ you lived here?
questions.why: Present Perfect: How long have you…?

questions.prompt: Why do people shorten words?
questions.why: У першому реченні: to type faster.

questions.prompt: What should a note about a bike include?
choices: Who took it and when it will be returned.
Only the price of the bike.
questions.why: У тексті прямо названо дві потрібні деталі.

write.prompt: Напиши записку про позичену річ і повідомлення про зміну планів. Додай речення з for і since.
write.starter: I borrowed… I will be back at… I have… for… since…

title: Going shopping
rule: Too + прикметник — надмірна ознака, що заважає: too small. Прикметник + enough — достатній ступінь: big enough. Not… enough — недостатньо. One замінює злічуваний іменник в однині, ones — у множині.
example: These shoes are too small. They are not big enough. I like the white ones. I will take the blue one.
reading: A teenager wants to buy a dress. She likes a blue one, but the first size is too big. The shop assistant brings a smaller one. There is a discount, and she tries the dress on before buying it. Another customer tries on shoes and asks for a larger size. They both keep their receipts.

questions.prompt: These shoes are ___ small for me.
This jacket is not warm ___.
I like these shoes, but I prefer the white ___.
What is wrong with the first dress?
questions.why: У тексті: the first size is too big.

questions.prompt: What do the customers keep?

write.prompt: Напиши діалог у крамниці: товар, розмір, too/enough, one/ones, ціна й спосіб оплати.
write.starter: Can I try…? It is too… Have you got a… one? I will take…

title: Teen problems
rule: Лист із проханням про пораду називає проблему, її причини, почуття і конкретне запитання. У відповіді використовуй I think you should… або Why don’t you…? Advice — незлічуваний іменник: some advice, a piece of advice. Порада має бути доброзичливою й посильною.
example: I need some advice. I feel worried. What should I do? I think you should explain how you feel.
reading: A student used to help a younger brother with all his homework. Now the student has exams and cannot help all the time. The brother gets upset and receives lower marks. An advice writer suggests explaining the situation and showing the brother how to study independently. The student also needs time for their own work.

questions.prompt: Choose a natural phrase.
I think you should ___ the problem.
A useful advice letter should…
choices: Describe the problem and ask a clear question.
questions.why: Зрозумілий опис допомагає дати доречну пораду.

questions.prompt: Why can the student not help all the time?
choices: The student is on a cruise.

questions.prompt: What does the advice writer suggest?
choices: Show the brother how to study independently.
Do every task for him forever.

write.prompt: Опиши вигадану шкільну проблему в 4 реченнях, потім дай дві доброзичливі поради.
write.starter: I feel… because… What should I do? I think you should…

title: In the headlines
rule: Who/that описує людей, which/that — предмети, тварин та ідеї у визначальних означальних реченнях. The girl who won… The prize which she received… Не додавай зайвий підмет після who. Прикметники можна утворювати від іменників: help → helpful, cloud → cloudy.
example: This is the girl who won a prize. That is the camera which she bought. He is a helpful person.
reading: A local newspaper reports on two teenagers who won prizes. One girl won a trip at a supermarket. She did not expect to win and wants to share the trip with a friend. Another teenager entered a competition and plans to enter more. Both stories explain who won, what they won and how they felt.

questions.prompt: The girl ___ won the prize is happy.
This is the camera ___ I bought.
Choose the adjective from help.
Where did the girl win a trip?
What does she want to do with the trip?
questions.why: У тексті: share the trip with a friend.

write.prompt: Напиши коротку новину про вигадану подію. Додай заголовок і два речення з who/which/that.
write.starter: A student who… won… The prize which… The winner felt…

title: Performing on stage
rule: So + допоміжне дієслово + підмет — «я теж» після ствердження. Neither + допоміжне дієслово + підмет — «я теж не» після заперечення. Підбирай допоміжне дієслово за часом: am, do, did, have, can, will. I like music → So do I. I can’t sing → Neither can I.
example: I am nervous. So am I. I love performing. So do I. I have not been on TV. Neither have I.
reading: A band is waiting for an audition. Two members feel nervous because a good performance could lead to a television appearance. Another member reminds them that they have worked hard. They agree that they enjoy performing together. They decide to do their best and have fun, even if they do not get on television.

questions.prompt: I am nervous. — ___ am I.
questions.why: Ствердження з am → So am I.

questions.prompt: I cannot sing. — Neither ___ I.
I played well. — So ___ I.
Why are two members nervous?
choices: The audition could lead to a TV appearance.
questions.why: Можливість виступу на TV робить подію важливою.

questions.prompt: What do they decide to do?
choices: Do their best and have fun.

write.prompt: Напиши 6 реплік діалогу про виступ. Використай so/neither щонайменше двічі.
write.starter: I am… So am I. I cannot… Neither can I. We will…

title: The press
rule: Present Simple Passive: am/is/are + третя форма. Важлива дія над предметом: The magazine is printed. Для множини: Copies are delivered. Заперечення: isn’t/aren’t + третя форма. Виконавця можна додати через by.
example: Articles are written by reporters. The magazine is designed on computers. Copies are delivered to shops.
reading: First, writers and editors meet and discuss topics. Reporters write articles and interview people. Graphic designers make the layout. The magazine is checked before it is sent to the printers. Many copies are printed, packed and delivered to shops. Readers can then buy the new issue.

questions.prompt: The magazine ___ printed every month.
Copies are ___ to shops.
Choose a passive sentence.
questions.why: Підмет articles отримує дію: are written.

questions.prompt: Who makes the layout?
questions.why: У тексті прямо названо graphic designers.

questions.prompt: What happens before the magazine goes to the printers?

write.prompt: Опиши процес створення шкільного журналу у 6 реченнях. Додай 3 речення в Passive.
write.starter: First… Articles are… The layout is… Copies are…

title: The Oscars
rule: Past Simple Passive: was/were + третя форма. Однина → was, множина → were. Запитання: Was/Were + підмет + третя форма? By називає виконавця. Не плутай активне directed (режисер зняв) і пасивне was directed (фільм знято).
example: The film was directed by a young director. Two awards were given. Was the scene filmed here?
reading: A film awards ceremony celebrates work in the film industry. Awards are given in different categories, such as acting and directing. At a school ceremony last year, one film was chosen as the best project. Two students were given awards for their acting. The audience enjoyed the event and applauded the winners.

questions.prompt: The film ___ chosen last year.
questions.why: Last year → Past Simple Passive з was.

questions.prompt: Two awards ___ given.
Was this scene ___ here?
Which film was chosen at the school ceremony?
questions.why: У тексті: chosen as the best project.

questions.prompt: How many students received acting awards?
questions.why: У тексті прямо названо two students.

write.prompt: Придумай шкільну церемонію. Напиши 5 речень про нагороди у Past Simple Passive.
write.starter: The ceremony was held… The best film was… Two awards were…

title: Films to watch
rule: Рецензія: перший абзац — назва, тип фільму, актори та короткий сюжет; другий — думка про гру, сюжет, музику й рекомендація. Сюжет описуй у Present Simple. Для створення фільму використовуй Passive, для уточнення персонажа — who/which/that.
example: The film was directed by a young artist. It is about a boy who helps his friends. I liked the plot and special effects.
reading: In this adventure film, a museum becomes an exciting place at night. Exhibits come to life, and the main character tries to help his friends. The review praises the acting and special effects but says the soundtrack is not very special. The writer recommends the film to people who enjoy funny adventures.

questions.prompt: A film's story is its ___.
Choose a passive sentence about a film.
choices: It was directed by an artist.

questions.prompt: It is about a girl ___ helps her friends.
What happens at night in the film?
